Hub for Spider-Man, Avengers, and Fantastic Four.

How New York City connects

  • Character: Spider-Man — Spider-Man protects New York City.
  • Faction: Fantastic Four — The Fantastic Four are based in New York City.

What is New York City?

New York City is Marvel's primary street-level stage—home turf for Spider-Man, the Fantastic Four, and many Avengers battles.

Key threads lead to Spider-Man and Fantastic Four.
